reviewWhy: SACM checks the mapping: no criticality reaches these CIs
title: No criticality reaches the CI
cardHint: No target and nothing inherited: no parent passes a criticality to the CI. Often a parent relationship is missing.
cardText: The owner is not asked for a target: criticality flows down from the Business Process. These CIs have no target and nothing inherited, so no parent passes a criticality to them. Often a parent relationship is missing, or the only parent is over a relationship excluded from calculation. SACM checks the mapping. A CI with Inherited set and Target empty waits two weeks: ServiceNow then copies Inherited to Target. A target without Inherited is fine.
